## Global Chat MCP Server

The Global Chat MCP server provides AI assistants with tools for cross-protocol agent discovery. It connects to the global-chat.io directory, which aggregates AI agents across MCP, A2A, and agents.txt protocols. Assistants can search a directory of agents across multiple registries, validate agents.txt files against the specification, list registered agents by type, and register new agents. The server is useful for agent-to-agent discovery workflows where finding and connecting to other AI agents is needed.
